findings.title: Forgeable _OfficialPermit
findings.reproduction: Construct _OfficialPermit with arbitrary fields and matching manifest digest; call public run/run_from_manifest with synthetic typed fixtures labelled REAL.
findings.actual: BYPASS_ACCEPTED; output says real, verified and official_authorization_verified=true.
findings.expected: Only run_official-issued permit after live readiness/EVAL-AUTH can authorize REAL evidence.
findings.consequence: Same-process caller bypasses permit issuance/authenticity; no protection against malicious same-process code.

findings.title: Alternate media readers unguarded
findings.reproduction: Static inspection only; protected files were not accessed.
findings.actual: PIL.Image.open, cv2.imread and cv2.VideoCapture paths lack repository media guard.
findings.expected: Every repository raw-media/image reader guarded or explicitly excluded with evidence.
findings.consequence: Alternate invocation may read repository media without AUTH-MEDIA-ACCESS; claimed complete inventory is not verified.

findings.title: Promotion receipt integrity
findings.evidence: 133 focused tests passed; forged receipt with wrong review set rejected; actual consumer rechecks receipt and second review.

findings.title: Unsafe routine suite/raw-media access
findings.evidence: Safe runner: 92 files, 1802 passed, 0 blocked, 0 violations; 4 raw-media tests excluded and not run.

findings.title: Reviewer/trigger/allowlist/identity/timestamp controls
findings.evidence: Focused synthetic tests pass; exact RD-043 proposal trigger set and qualified identity enforcement observed.

findings.title: No descriptive back-stream cache route
findings.evidence: Official producer has independent back system; cache supports B0/B1/B2 only; B0_back/B2_back provisional and refused.

findings.title: Reproducibility incomplete

findings.title: References/authors
